text:
maya: Heads-up — I just saw an operator account promote a feature flag straight to prod without the canary gate running. Not good.

maya: snippet from rollout service logs:
```
INFO 2025-04-12T14:12:03Z rollout.start user=operator-13 flag=alpha target=prod mode=instant
WARN 2025-04-12T14:12:03Z rollout.bypass reason=missing_canary_check user=operator-13
```

lin: wait, missing_canary_check? we have an RBAC rule that should require canary_scope for rollouts. did we change something in rbac_v2? :eyes:

alex: i merged rbac_v2 yesterday — I thought we kept rollout checks intact. I'll take a look now. Which service exactly?

maya: rollout-service in infra/ops; policy lookup goes through role-mapper -> role-template -> permission-set. It looks like the mapping for service-account principals dropped the canary tag check. config diff:
```
- role: rollout.operator
- checks: [canary_scope, env:prod_block]
+ role: rollout.operator
+ checks: [env:prod_block]
```

lin: ahhh that explains it. the canary_scope predicate was accidentally removed during the role-template refactor.

sre_oncall: rolling back the prod promotion now. deploy-bot, cancel the job and set flag alpha back to paused.

deploy-bot: cancel acknowledged for job 87621. flag alpha state -> paused. :white_check_mark:

alex: pushing hotfix to restore canary_scope predicate and add integration test. will also add an explicit check in rollout handler as belt-and-suspenders.

maya: also noticed KMS audit entries don't show the operator wrapping event — KMS logs show an encrypt call at 14:11 but no corresponding key-access audit for operator-13 at that exact time. possible async log loss? worth investigating.

lin: KMS logs from cloud: there is an encrypt/Decrypt record at 14:11:58, but the principal is service-account:rollout-proxy, not operator-13. suggests the proxy performed ops on behalf of operator but permission decision happened earlier. we need to tie the proxy->principal mapping into audit logs.

security-bot: created SEC-4721: "rollout-service: missing canary_scope after rbac_v2 merge; audit trail gap for proxy principal mapping". assigned to alex + maya. priority=P1.

alex: working on a two-part fix: 1) immediate revert of role-template diff + hotfix in rollout-service middleware, 2) add logging that emits user_principal and effective_roles to KMS request context. will send a PR in ~15m.

maya: thanks. quick ask: can we also add a temporary firewall rule that prevents operator-*-acct service principals from doing instant production promotions until SEC-4721 closes? low blast radius and fast to enforce.

sre_oncall: can do. will add a deny rule scoped to principal pattern operator-* for route /rollout/v1/promote (applied at edge) and keep it for 24h.

lin: once alex has the PR, i'll run the regression harness against the rollout CI matrix and ensure canary gating is enforced.

maya: noted. after hotfix + rollback I'll audit the last 48h of role-template changes and KMS logs to ensure no other silent gaps. posting updates here. :thumbsup:

alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/rollout/pull/492 — hotfix + test. please review.

maya: confirmed rollback complete, proxy logs show the extra canary check firing now. leaving SEC-4721 open until postmortem is written.

lin: filing short postmortem and adding a check in the pre-merge CI for role-template diffs that remove security predicates.

sre_oncall: deployed edge deny rule. will remove after SEC signoff.

maya: thanks everyone. next steps: postmortem (lin), KMS audit correlation (alex), 24h deny window (sre_oncall). I'll update SEC ticket with timelines.
